description: List every overload (parameters, generics, return type) of one or more methods or constructors ("<init>") of a dependency class. Use to verify a call or pick an overload. Not for bodies: use get_class_source.

className.description: FQN, e.g. com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper; a unique simple name works.

modulePath.description: Gradle path like ':app', or a file/dir inside the module. Omit (or "*") for all modules.

projectRoot.description: Project root. Omit to use the workspace.

name: get_method_signature
title: Get Java method overload signatures
